answer: Because the mirror stake is held until the canyon settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the prism audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 11% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A farm running 107 keys hence forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
